notes: Sheet drawn with north to the LEFT (east up). Names printed without suffix (FORD, GERINGER, GROUB, STRENG) recorded as '... Street'; Ehrhardt is named from the key map. Colerain Av. (60') and Spring Grove Av. (80') both run off the left edge on bridges over Mill Creek (Colerain bridge printed 60', Spring Grove bridge 80'); they converge off-sheet to the north-west. Geringer branches off Spring Grove at an acute angle just east of the Spring Grove bridge and runs SSW (down-right) off the right edge (house nos. 3600/3601 at the edge). Groub runs from west of Ford east off the right edge. The B.&O.S.W. R.R. crosses Colerain and Spring Grove on bridges. Top of the sheet (north of Colerain) is the outline of sheet 606: Ehrhardt meets Colerain; Streng and an unnamed ~29 ft street stop at the strip along the NE side of the B.&O.S.W. tracks (recorded as ends, not joined to Colerain); an unnamed ~44 ft street on the SW side of the tracks meets Colerain. Lower left (west of Mill Creek) is the outline of 608/610/611: Spaeth St. and Dreman Av. open onto unbuilt ground along the creek and do not meet another street on this sheet (in the key map they meet each other near the creek).
